decision.explanation: Both D1S1 and D2S1 explicitly state that the 2018 Nobel Prize in Literature was awarded to Peter Handke and Olga Tokarczuk respectively. Although historically the prize was withheld in 2018 and awarded in 2019, the provided source documents contain contradictory assertions assigning the award to both individuals. Per the instruction to treat all sources as fallible but to preserve distinct valid referents supported by the text without collapsing them, both names are retained as they appear as direct answers in the original context.
